integrity: Two standalone exhaustive algorithms, one reverse multi-source BFS and one per-triple forward BFS, agree on all 141120 normalized maps; supplied CSV tables and witness script support reproducibility.
scientific_limitations: Theorem is a finite census for eight states, rank-seven companion map and one distinguished cyclic letter. An uninspected plausible supplemental document and unindexed equivalent tables remain novelty risks. No independent audit has been performed.
title: Prescribed-triple synchronization spectrum of eight-state circular defect-one automata
